title: Pandemic
note: Answer-level eval for Ask. Pass = answer text matches `must` (case-insensitive regex), does not match `mustNot`, carries at least one citation, and has no citation warning. `expected` is the human-readable truth; `source` is where the question was found (forum/FAQ) or noted as rulebook-derived. Found by web search 2026-10-15; BGG pages block automated reading, so expectations were checked against the publisher rulebook text.

questions.q: What is the hand limit in Pandemic?
questions.expected: 7 cards; discard or play events down to 7.

questions.q: Can I discard cards voluntarily when I'm under the hand limit?
questions.expected: No: you discard only when over the limit or as part of an action.

questions.q: Does a disease count as eradicated if I haven't cured it yet?
questions.expected: No: it must be cured first and then have no cubes left on the board.

questions.q: Do I have to be in the same city to Share Knowledge?
questions.expected: Yes, both pawns must be in the same city; the card given must be that city's card (Researcher differs).

questions.q: How many cards of the same color do I need to discover a cure?
questions.expected: 5 City cards of the same color at a research station (4 for the Scientist).

questions.q: How many outbreaks make the players lose?
How many roles are there in Pandemic?
questions.expected: 7 roles (derived: 7 role cards listed; no number printed in the rules text).

questions.q: List all the roles in Pandemic.
questions.expected: Contingency Planner, Dispatcher, Medic, Operations Expert, Quarantine Specialist, Researcher, Scientist.

questions.q: What happens if I draw two Epidemic cards at once?
questions.expected: Resolve them one after another; the second epidemic's infect card is the new bottom card; events can be played between.

questions.q: Does the Contingency Planner's stored event card count toward the hand limit?
questions.expected: No, it does not count against the hand limit.
